title: Freya and the Hymn
author: Vesper Joubert
blurb: Xanthe Eastwick, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the harvest moon rises.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
